::: {#exm-confidence-interval-wcgs}
#### Confidence interval for mean cholesterol in the WCGS

<!-- Repoint the CLT link to pds (limit-theorems.qmd#sec-clt) once pds is published. -->
By the [central limit theorem](https://morrison-lab.github.io/rme/chapters/probability.html#the-central-limit-theorem),
the sample mean $\bar X$ of a large sample
has approximately a Gaussian distribution
with mean $\mu$ and
[standard error](estimation.qmd#def-SE) $\sigma/\sqrt{n}$,
which we estimate by $s/\sqrt{n}$.
So $\bar x \pm z_{0.975} \, s/\sqrt{n}$,
where $z_{0.975} \approx 1.96$ is the 0.975 quantile
of the standard Gaussian distribution,
is an [approximate](#def-approximate-ci) 95% confidence interval for $\mu$:

```{r}
chol <- wcgs$chol[!is.na(wcgs$chol)]
se_chol <- sd(chol) / sqrt(length(chol))
mean(chol) + c(lower = -1, upper = 1) * qnorm(0.975) * se_chol
```

:::
